summary: This is a routine form 6-K filed by Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. providing the call notice and manual for an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on June 30, 2026. The agenda includes ratification of PricewaterhouseCoopers to prepare an appraisal report for Esfera Fidelidade S.A., approval of the report, and approval of the merger of Esfera into the company. There are no terms such as price, premium, or advisor for a sale/merger event disclosed in this filing—only procedural items for a shareholder vote on a corporate restructuring. As an EGM notice with a proposed merger, but lacking any deal terms, this filing is not a special-situation trigger event; it is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer.
